October 29, 2026               
     
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
Sub: - Earnings Call recording pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, and in continuation of our letter dated October 26, 2026, we wish to inform 
you that the audio recording of the Earnings Call held on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 12:00 
Noon (IST), with respect to the financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year 
ended September 30, 2026, is available on the Company’s website and can be accessed at the 
following link:  
 
https://files.iiflcapital.com/assets/10048492_32fae12190.mp3 
 
Kindly take the same on record and oblige. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For IIFL Capital Services Limited 
(Formerly IIFL Securities Limited) 
 
            
 
  
 
Meghal Shah 
Company Secretary
